Formatting / presentation
* Please study the formatting syntax described on this page: https://www.codingame.com/playgrounds/40701/help-center/statement , and format your statement properly as described in the points below.

Goal
* Please format "N" as a [[variable]].

Input
* Please format all variable names (N, start, end) as [[variables]].

* Please follow the example shown in the above-mentioned link to simplify the section:

  - Change "The first line contains an" to "<<Line 1>>: An".
  
  - Change "The next N lines each contain two" to "<<Next [[N]] lines>>: Each line contains two space-separated".

Output
* Please change "Print a" to "<<Line 1>>: A".

Constraints
* Please format all variable names (N, start, end) as [[variables]].

* Please change 10^5 to 100 as [[N]] never exceeds 10 in the current cases.

* Please change 10^9 to 100 as [[start]] and [[end]] never exceed 100 in the current cases.

Cases
* Each test and its validator should cover the same scenario, differing only slightly in inputs and outputs. Please revise the cases accordingly.

* Please rename the cases with descriptions of the scenarios they cover. Alternatively, you can reply here with a brief summary of the scenario covered by each case pair (test + validator).

* Please add a case pair that includes multiple pairs of meetings, each of which share the same start time but have different end times.

* Please add a case pair that includes multiple pairs of meetings, each of which share the same end time but have different start times.

* Please add a case pair that includes multiple pairs of meetings, each of which share the same start time and the same end time.

* Please add a case pair that combines all three of the scenarios mentioned above in a single test, with multiple overlaps.

* Please add some cases with highly randomised inputs.

Thanks.

5DN1L will probably show up in a minute to tell you about the formatting and the duplicated validators.
